references.label: Bridge item lane
references.description: One of five lanes that collects the current item when its white arrow flashes.

references.label: Change Item target
references.description: The standup that moves the item collection arrow; after an inlane it flashes and also advances the active item.

references.label: Ramp-award shot
references.description: Every third shot advances the repeating award cycle; its first award lights both Mega Mode starts.

references.label: Trap scoop
references.description: One of two scoops that starts Mega Mode when lit.

references.label: Pit scoop
references.description: The second scoop that starts Mega Mode when lit.

references.label: Secret Door shot
references.description: The hidden left-orbit-side shot used to start Skull's Doom Mode.
